steps.description: Tie the room to a Location so bookings and assets roll up by building or campus.
steps.label: Where It Is
steps.title: Where It Is

steps.description: Enable to allow Room Bookings against it. A booking of a room that is not bookable is refused.
steps.label: Bookable
steps.title: Bookable

steps.description: Tick this when an approver must approve each booking. Then add users to Approvers: each needs the Church Staff or Church Manager role. Leave Approvers empty to let the Church Managers of the church approve. Approvers get a ToDo for each request, and only an approver can block a time.
steps.label: Requires Approval
steps.title: Approval

steps.description: Choose a Question Set to ask each booking of this room some questions, such as the number of guests. The booking form opens the questions when someone chooses the room.
steps.label: Question Set
steps.title: Questions

steps.description: List the ways this room can be set up, such as Banquet or Theatre. Give each setup its own name. A booking can then choose one of them.
steps.label: Setups
steps.title: Setups
